question: What understanding has been attained through the grace of the lord of Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Understanding arises by that lord's grace
The determination of Kaula is now known
inference: By the lord of Kaulas' grace, the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
